subject: Well...
author: UISProphet
body:
Well, that's completely up to you.  If it makes you feel any better, those of us that started the game back in January 2008 had to do this very same thing when the trophies were released, as they were not made retroactive.  I had to do it to get the trophy you're after, and just about every other trophy as well.

I guess it just depends on how much of a completionist you are and how important the trophies are to you.

Love, Prophet

subject: fellow trophy whore
author: UISProphet
body:
I've heard of trophies not showing up before.  If you have over 200 smashes, but no trophy, then I'm afraid there's only one thing you can do.  While this may sound drastic, it really isn't and it won't take long.

1. Back up your current gamesave to a memory stick.

2. Delete the gamesave from your PS3.

3. Start a new game and just go for smashes.  You're only going for 200 of the 400, so it really shouldn't take THAT long.

4. Once you get the trophy, exit the game and delete this newly created gamesave.

5. Restore your original gamesave from the memory stick.

6. Enjoy your trophy and the road to 100% 👍

 

Love, Prophet
